description: This file defines classes and logic for indexing numeric content fields within OrchardCore CMS, specifically implementing a provider for SQL indexing of numeric fields.

classes.name: NumericFieldIndex
classes.description: Represents an index entry for a numeric content field, including the numeric value and related metadata.

classes.name: NumericFieldIndexProvider
classes.description: Provides indexing logic for numeric fields in content items, implementing the Describe method to map content items to index entries.

methods.name: NumericFieldIndexProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service provider dependency.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Defines how content items are mapped to index entries for numeric fields, including filtering and lazy loading of content type definitions.
